name: Kronos
description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
one_liner: A free, pre-trained AI model that reads a stock or crypto chart's price history and forecasts what it might do next, trained on data from over 45 exchanges worldwide.
buyer: A quant trading hobbyist or small fintech team who wants a ready-made price-forecasting model instead of training one from scratch.
business_use_cases: A small prop trading shop uses it as a baseline signal generator, layering their own risk management and execution logic on top.
A retail trading app adds an 'AI forecast' feature to its charts using this model, as a premium differentiator over free charting tools.
An independent trader builds and sells a subscription newsletter or Discord bot that posts the model's daily forecasts on popular tickers.

money_ideas.idea: Build a subscription signal service or bot that publishes the model's forecasts for a curated list of assets.
Offer custom fine-tuning and integration services for trading firms who want it adapted to their specific instruments.

steal_this: Wire the live demo's forecasting logic into a simple Discord bot this weekend that posts a daily forecast for a handful of popular crypto pairs, and charge for access to the premium ticker list.
